title: Muldowney's Irish Potato Candy
description: These sweet, coconut-flavored Irish potatoes are balls of candy coated with cinnamon to look like potatoes--they're perfect for serving around St. Patrick's Day.
ingredients: 2 (16 ounce) packages confectioners' sugar, or to taste
1 (14 ounce) package shredded coconut, or to taste
0.33333334326744 cup light corn syrup (such as Karo®)
0.5 cup ground cinnamon, or as needed

steps.text: Place softened butter in a large bowl. Add confectioners' sugar, coconut, corn syrup, and vanilla extract; mix using your hands until combined. Knead until it holds together but is not too sticky, adding more sugar and coconut, if needed.
Place cinnamon on a plate. Form the mixture into small, round balls and roll in the cinnamon until coated and they look like tiny potatoes.
